svg.title: Work description source-of-truth architecture
svg.desc: Three-layer diagram showing which data sources feed each element of a Government of Canada work description: org-level elements from the DRF and intranet, job-level elements from the job architecture and JES benchmarks, and administrative fields from PeopleSoft and HR systems.

g.text: Policy layer — what the Directive mandates
Feeds: org context, client service results, working conditions
Feeds: key activities, skills, effort, responsibilities
Org: org context · client service results
Admin: title · position no. · supervisor · effective date · signature
